subject: Post-call: NexaHealth POC evaluation roadmap and rubric

Subject: Post-call: NexaHealth POC evaluation roadmap and rubric

Hi Maya — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking through your primary objectives for the pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I put the plan into a shared doc: 

1) Goal: Reduce average support deflection time for triage workflows by 30% on your sampled ambulatory triage volume, without raising false positives above 5%.
2) Scope: 2-week shadow period (online) + offline grading against a 300-message test set for edge cases.
3) Success criteria (proposal):
   - Primary metric: mean time-to-first-action improvement >= 30% vs baseline (shadow) OR equivalent throughput improvement in offline sim + calibrated threshold that meets FP <5%.
   - Secondary metrics: user satisfaction (CSAT) >= 4.0 on sampled escalations, precision at top-1 >= 0.88 on curated test set.
4) Ownership: Redwood will provide the inference endpoints, real-time telemetry for the shadow run, and an offline rubric for graders. Nexa to provide sample datasets, a tech contact for SSO/VPN access, and a product lead for scoring subjective items (CSAT).
5) Timeline (high level):
   - This week: Exchange rubric + data access plan (I attach a draft rubric and timeline).
   - Week 2: Offline grading on curated set (we’ll ship annotation sheet + instructions).
   - Week 3: 2-week live shadow (parallel read-only inference).
   - Week 5: Joint scorecard and go/no-go decision.

Please confirm if the metric framing works for you (especially the 30% deflection target and the 5% FP cap). I can pivot to a precision/recall framing if you prefer offline-first evaluation.

Attachments: Nexa_Eval_Rubric_v1.xlsx, Nexa_POC_Timeline_v1.pdf

Next steps I propose from Redwood: share rubric and a short video walkthrough for your product team; schedule a 30-min alignment with your engineers to sort data access (SSO/KV endpoints); and confirm procurement touchpoint.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the shared Drive link and a HubSpot task after you confirm.

Best,

Great questions — thanks for calling those out. Short answers first then detail below: offline-first approach is totally fine and recommended; Redwood can provide the annotation guide and run a first-pass grading (we'll share results and any high-frequency failure categories), then pivot to a short live shadow once thresholds are met. Attached is the rubric (v1) and a suggested timeline PDF. 

How we measure deflection vs offline sim:
- Shadow (online read-only): we compare Redwood suggestions against the actions taken in your system and measure time-to-first-action when the suggestion would have been available. This is a conservative estimate because we do not auto-execute in shadow mode; we only log timestamps and hypothetical acceptance.
- Offline sim: we run the model against a curated test set and measure precision@k, recall on labeled intents, and a calibrated threshold that aims to meet your FP cap. Offline helps identify edge cases and calibration needs without exposure to live traffic.

Grader model and responsibilities:
- Recommendation: Redwood will deliver the annotation guide and a pre-populated annotation spreadsheet. Redwood’s evaluation team can perform the initial pass on the 300-message core set to identify broad failure modes (cost included in pilot). Nexa product SMEs should do a final consensus pass on a focused 50-message adjudication set for subjective items (CSAT labels, clinical appropriateness).

Proposed rubric highlights (attached):
- For each example: Category (triage intent), Gold label, Model suggestion, Confidence score, Binary correctness, Notes (clinical risk), CSAT proxy (1-5).
- Scoring: correct=1, partial=0.5, incorrect=0. Fail threshold: aggregate precision < 0.88 or CSAT proxy avg < 3.8 -> iterate; target go threshold: precision >= 0.88 AND CSAT proxy >= 4.0.

Logistics & security notes:
- Read-only shadow endpoints, IP allowlisting, and token rotation are supported. We’ll need an SSO contact for the private endpoint (Carlos?).

I’m attaching:
- Nexa_Eval_Rubric_v1.xlsx (rubric + annotation guide)
- Nexa_POC_Timeline_v1.pdf (timeline + milestones)

Can you confirm: 1) offline-first approach? 2) who on Nexa will be the SME for adjudication (name + email)? Once we have that I’ll schedule the engineering alignment and lock the timeline.

Thanks — I’ll also open a HubSpot task and share the Drive folder.

Best,
